title: Visual Studio 2022 version 17.8.6
body_markdown:
*released Jan 30th, 2024*

### Summary of What's New in this Release of Visual Studio 2022 version 17.8.6

### Developer Community

* [Incorrect coloring of parameters for CreateWindow and no quick info](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/The-new-version-cannot-use-CreateWindow-/10538020)
* [Update VS 2022 to Node 18](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/VS2022-is-using-too-old-nodejs-version-/10559468)
* [Problem building c++/clr projects in VS17.8](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Problem-building-cclr-projects-in-VS1/10517872)
* [ARM64EC updating 17.8preview1 to preview3 gets errors: libvcruntime.lib(overrides.obj) : error LNK2013: BRANCH26 fixup overflow. Target '#memcpy\_unal](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/ARM64EC-updating-178preview1-to-preview/10491228)
* [ARM64EC LNK1000 Internal error during IMAGE::BuildImage due to crash in link!CollectLongBranch](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/ARM64EC-LNK1000-Internal-error-during-IM/10445144)
* [Illegal Instruction (SSE 4.2 POPCNT) exception in VC Runtime 14.38.33130 concrt140.dll on Intel Core 2 Quad Q6600](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Illegal-Instruction-SSE-42-POPCNT-exc/10520578)
  + The fix requires an update to the VC Redistributable. For this update of 17.8, Visual Studio will not automatically update the VC Redistributable. To correctly apply the fix, after installing this update for Visual Studio, users will need to run the VC Redistributable executable for the target architecture available at `C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Enterprise\VC\Redist\MSVC\<latest version>`. App local deployments should copy the relevant VC runtime binaries from the same folder under `arm64` or `x64`, `x86` subfolders.
* [fatal error C1001: Internal compiler error](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/fatal-error-C1001:-Internal-compiler-err/10005116)
* [Visual Studio 2022 Invalid optimization code post increment in conditional](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Visual-Studio-2022-Invalid-optimization-/10506679)
* [VS17.8 ARM64EC Release build code generation bug while copying to intrinsic type \_\_n64](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/VS178-ARM64EC-Release-build-code-genera/10551568)
* [Compiler 19.37.32825 generates incorrect assembly LDRSH when accessing uint16\_t with /O2](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Compiler-193732825-generates-incorrect/10531998)

---
